name: MotherDuck
description: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. Create Dives: interactive visualizations that let you save and share answers with your team, staying up-to-date with your latest data. Works with real-world data without requiring semantic models or pre-configuration. Your AI assistant acts like a data analyst, exploring, validating, analyzing, and visualizing data iteratively to answer your questions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MotherDuck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MotherDuck to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.motherduck.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is MotherDuck MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, MotherDuck scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MotherDuck MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MotherDuck lists 15 MCP tools, including list_databases, list_shares, list_tables, list_columns, search_catalog, query, ask_docs_question, query_rw, get_dive_guide, save_dive, read_dive, and update_dive.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MotherDuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MotherDuck in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
MotherDuck requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MotherDuck is developed by MotherDuck Corporation. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
